integrity: The proof derives an exact terminating, uniquely normalizing pair of rewriting relations. An accompanying standard-Python verifier independently enumerates 9,556 monoid elements not exceeding 10^20 and cross-checks full factorization counts and length sets. No outside audit claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only the multiplicative monoid of Jordan–Pólya numbers with prime support at most 13, and only its eight-atom factorizations; arbitrary factorial-product representation counts and larger prime supports are not claimed. Prior fixed-support coordinate descriptions underpin the proof; an unstated or unindexed equivalent minimal presentation remains possible. Finite checks do not prove unbounded results.
title: Two defining relations and complete atomic factorization theory for thirteen-smooth Jordan–Pólya numbers
